script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: He guesses why Paul goes back to Adam. Marking it as a guess does not permit adding a reason Paul does not give.
Calling Adam the first man is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage says death reigned before the law was given, not before any law was handed down.
Calling Noah the 'wrong stop' says 'wrong' about the baker's answer.
David coming after Moses is a fact outside this passage and needs a reference. The reference given establishes that David was king, not the timeline.
Saying people copied Adam's exact move adds deliberate imitation that the passage does not state.
People who did not sin in the way Adam transgressed are described as people who never did what Adam did. The passage does not say that.
Saying Paul has his hands in the air adds an action the text does not give.
The passage says the gift followed many trespasses, not that the gift gets bigger as the number of trespasses grows.
Paul says those who receive grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life. He does not say life now reigns through Christ.
Paul says those who receive grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life, not that life reigns through Christ.
